text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bourbon-chan!
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I'm scheduled to run in the next mock race!
So, um... could you maybe give me
some training advice?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: From myself?

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The menu you showed me before was
so easy to understand, and it really improved my skill—

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I've never managed to place on the board before,
but I really want to try this time. ...Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Negative. Mission "Support",
accepted.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I saw everything! Helping one another and charging toward victory
—as class president, I am immensely proud!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Cherry blossoms touched by warm breezes bloom all the sooner." 
This will definitely go well, desu ne!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san, if there's anything Rice can do
to help, just let me know...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged with thanks. Commencing joint mission
"Create Special Training Menu."
Let us provide full support to our classmate.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To build leg strength and stamina, I propose
incorporating shrine staircase climbs into the menu.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sounds splendid! Let us forge a bakushin body
that yields neither to rain, wind, nor stairs!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, tire pulls will be introduced.
Rice-san, sharing similar physique, distance aptitude,
and running style, may I request your assistance to calculate lap counts?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Understood, Rice will do her best...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll sit on the tire to monitor the pace
and send cheers on top of it!
Fight, Oh! Chiyono, Oh!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. With everyone's cooperation,
we can construct an effective routine—designed for victory.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad...
I really hope she can win this time...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Um... Bourbon-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter? We have trained daily,
and I calculate the results have manifested properly.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
The thing is... I heard a girl who's way
stronger than me is entering the same race,
and I got really scared—

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm terribly sorry to Bourbon-chan,
but I'm thinking of withdrawing this time...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What did you say!? After working so hard
for the sake of this mock race!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I know that... I really do, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...So that's what happened...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Being in a race with someone super strong
is definitely scary.
But after she worked so hard, desu ne...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. I, too, desire for her
to run a race that leaves no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, would you lend your assistance
to an emergency mission?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Previously, when my status had deteriorated,
Bakushin O-san and the others cheered for me
and shared their courage.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
There was also a time when Tannhauser-san and Ikuno-san
thanked me for my cheers,
which helped them clear a difficult mission.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...This time as well, using the power of cheering,
I wish to supply her with the energy to enter the mock race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! As class president,
I shall cooperate with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then, I request assistance with mission "Bento Preparation."
We shall prepare highly nutritious refreshments
and recharge both her mind and body with energy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A bento full of support...
Yeah...! Rice will make a super tasty bento
so she can find the courage to run...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Here. This is a refreshment from us.
We prepared it with care and emotion.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... wait, huh?
Is there a message card too...?

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: ............"Good luck with your race."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not possess the authority to cancel your order to withdraw.
However—I wish to see you run.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
...
I'll take a bite, then.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
...Delicious...
It's... so delicious.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
............After receiving a gift like this,
I have no choice but to give it my all...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status "Courage" detected.
Meaning, you will—

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I... I'll enter the race!
No matter the outcome, I'll run with everything I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The exchange between Mihono Bourbon and her classmate
warmed the hearts of everyone watching.
